## Change

Describe the problem and resulting player or developer behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. For visual or interaction changes, include a screenshot or a short playtest account. State anything not tested.

## Review notes

Mention meaningful tradeoffs, save-data effects, or follow-up work; omit this section when unnecessary.
